notes.title: Linux and SteamOS release !
notes.content:
Hello 👋

The official Linux build has been released! 
You can now enjoy Trigger of Time on your Steam Deck natively.

It should play around 40fps on the Steam Deck. I recommand reducing the render scaling to .8 to get a smoother experience.

The game cannot yet be verified on SteamOS because it's not yet trusted by Steam, I guess it needs more sales / reviews. There is no documentation about that. As soon as it's possible, I will make it verified.

Don't hesitate to give feedback on the game either here or on the official discord. Thank you!

Changelog:

 Released native Linux 64 build
 Fixed saving and loading states of many props (door, motors, buttons...)
 Fixed the "Speedrunner" achievement, you had to die once in the run to get it, now you actually need to speedrun the game.
 Fixed head bobbing and weapon sway going wild when player would go light speed
 A lot of small errors fixed and a lot of cleaning in the project

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
Hello! 

More bug fixes and quality-of-life changes mainly focused on improving both movements and controller support 🥸

We're close to the 10 reviews threshold which is a big step to be considered legit by Steam and being suggested to players 🤞 Thank you again to everyone who played the game so far!


Changelog:


 Improved controller handling, movements should be more precise and smoother
 Increased coyote time from 0.25s to 0.35s for better jump forgiveness
 Made jump directionality more responsive
 Fixed grab issue with notes
 Added an interaction to flip notes if they're upside down
 Increased button interactable zone
 Splitted sensivity into mouse sensivity and controller sensivity
 Change the default controller keybind of sprint to LB
 Fixed timegun red crystals not showing up on load

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
First of all, thank you so much to everyone who played the game! ✨
And a special shoutout to those who left a review — it really means a lot and helps me improve future games.

Then, there were some nasty bugs that needed eradication.

Changelog:


 Fixed a blocking issue where if you fell and restart, you would be blocked and floating in the world
 Fixed an issue where the music would start again after dying
 Fixed an issue with new game that would not properly reset the previous save
 Fixed a collision after the second big door
 Various small tweaks and collision fixes.
